description: Source code for the ProgramTable class in the elf_loader component, handling ELF program headers, segment loading, memory mapping, and related operations.

classes.name: ProgramTable
classes.description: Handles ELF program headers, segment loading, memory mapping, and related operations within the elf_loader namespace.

methods.name: LoadProgramHeader
methods.description: Loads and maps the ELF program header table from a file.

methods.name: LoadSegments
methods.description: Loads ELF segments into memory, handling PT_LOAD and PT_NOTE types.

methods.name: GetLoadMemorySize
methods.description: Calculates total memory size needed for loadable segments.

methods.name: GetDynamicSection
methods.description: Retrieves the dynamic section from ELF headers.

methods.name: AdjustMemoryProtectionOfReadOnlySegments
methods.description: Adjusts memory protections for read-only segments.

methods.name: ReserveLoadMemory
methods.description: Reserves address space for loading segments.

methods.name: PublishEvergreenInfo
methods.description: Publishes metadata about the loaded ELF image.

methods.name: GetBaseMemoryAddress
methods.description: Returns the base address of the loaded ELF image.
